content.scenario: A consumer, Mr. X, signs a contract with a mobile phone service provider that requires him to pay a security deposit of Rs. 10,000, which is manifestly excessive compared to the monthly charges. The contract also states that if Mr. X breaches the contract, he will have to pay a penalty of Rs. 5,000, which is wholly disproportionate to the loss that the service provider may incur.
content.outcome: The contract is considered unfair as it requires an excessive security deposit and imposes a disproportionate penalty for breach of contract, causing a significant change in the rights of the consumer.
